ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: the query asks for a single concrete example illustrating a given statement — a bounded, clearly-specified task rather than open-ended invention. Lapwing self-reports preferring exactly this kind of well-specified request, while Dunlin reports its strongest appetite for high-latitude generative work. Since capability is effectively tied across the fleet (all eval differences here are within variance), I leaned on the preference match to pick the model likelier to be well-suited to this task type. Both would handle it fine, so this was a marginal, preference-based call rather than a capability-driven one.
